acceptance_criteria: A current health observation of a long-lived active provider does not become stale solely from lastSessionStartedAt age.
A recent session start without progress or success evidence is not labeled fresh provider readiness.
Observation age, process liveness, session lifetime, and progress age are separately serialized and tested.
Fresh successful-turn or probe evidence can contradict a headless authentication false negative only under an explicit bounded policy.
Active-but-idle, active-and-progressing, active-but-stalled, newly started, recently successful, and process-dead states have distinct deterministic dispositions.
Health and database evidence with mismatched provider, generation, or time authority cannot be combined into fresh corroboration.
Restart changes session generation but cannot manufacture provider recovery until a post-restart success or progress predicate is satisfied.
Clock skew, missing or invalid timestamps, stale observations, long idle periods, and process-identity reuse are fault-injected.
The provider-probe incident opens, downgrades, refreshes, and clears only through source-qualified evidence transitions.
Exact-byte privacy tests reject process or session identifiers, paths, commands, raw output, credentials, host or account identity, and content.
blast_radius: Scheduled provider-probe truth, headless credential diagnosis, runtime provider evidence, restart and self-healing decisions, alert incident transitions, and confidence in shared provider health.
evidence_summary: Three stable live identity reads pinned open issue #2546 to node I_kwDOR1Sep88AAAABKQzSxg, its current title, P1, SSOT, alerts, audit, bug, and reliability labels, update time, URL, and exact 9,949-byte body hash while the SSH remote main remained de3f69bbb5648b804ea2843d310c47dda544a056. The prior audited main and this revision have identical bytes for every decisive and affected path. Exact-main source inspection confirms the health corroborator calculates freshness from session start age, while the database corroborator selects the newest session start or message timestamp and applies the same age limit. A direct exact-source falsifier returned fresh=false for a current provider-matched health observation with a long-lived active session and fresh=true for a recently started active session with no progress evidence. The exact bot-errors TypeScript and focused provider-probe Python suites passed 165 of 165 tests. A fresh fully paginated scan covered all 36 open pull requests and 1,276 changed-file rows, found 19 touched-path overlaps plus taxonomy coordination in draft PR #2451, and found no implementation owner.
falsifier_or_remaining_gap: The finding would be falsified if observation freshness and provider progress were evaluated independently from session lifetime. Exact source execution instead rejected the long-lived active sample and accepted recent process birth without progress. Passing existing tests establish the current recently-started safeguard, not the missing four-axis contract; production incidence, idle policy, and progress thresholds remain implementation-time measurements.
impact: A healthy long-lived provider can stop contradicting a headless authentication false negative merely because it was not restarted recently, while a newly started but unproven child is overtrusted. Restart timing can therefore masquerade as provider recovery.
lead_verification_obligations: Re-read issue #2546 immediately before registry integration and reject this record if its state, node ID, title, labels, update time, URL, or exact body hash changed.
Reconfirm the SSH origin, local origin/main, remote main, and every decisive path byte before implementation.
Re-scan all open pull requests, merged PR #769, and draft PR #2451 immediately before dispatch; preserve one implementation owner.
Define observation freshness, exact-process liveness, progress or success freshness, and session lifetime as separate typed axes through #2447.
Reuse #2340's progress primitive only when it identifies the same provider execution generation; keep #2358 envelope provenance separate.
Land the behavior contract before #2464 consolidates Python helpers so consolidation cannot preserve the start-time proxy.
Add RED and GREEN time, process, progress, provider, restart, skew, invalid-timestamp, stale-observation, and process-reuse matrices.
Prove insufficient or mismatched evidence becomes inconclusive rather than fresh readiness or actionable authentication failure.
Run both decisive suites plus runtime, core-health, and broader deployment checks against committed implementation bytes.
